Option II is true, since every vertex must have at least one outgoing edge.

Option III is true, since every vertex must have at least one incoming or outgoing edge.

The histogram of the given image is as follows:

| Intensity Level | Number of Pixels |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | 4 |
| 1 | 3 |
| 2 | 2 |
| 3 | 5 |
| 4 | 7 |
| 5 | 6 |
| 6 | 5 |
| 7 | 4 |

From the histogram, we can see that the majority of the pixels have an intensity value of 4 or 5. Therefore, an appropriate threshold value would be around 4 or 5.
